retrieved_evidence.title: Late deliveries
retrieved_evidence.text: If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

retrieved_evidence.title: Delivery times
retrieved_evidence.text:
| Delivery type | Metro cities | Other locations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.

retrieved_evidence.title: Benefits
retrieved_evidence.text:
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.

retrieved_evidence.title: Expired or failed coupons
retrieved_evidence.text: A coupon that was valid but failed to apply because of a technical error can be re-issued once by support if the order was placed within the coupon's validity. Coupons that had already expired cannot be re-issued.

retrieved_evidence.title: Partial refunds and coupons
retrieved_evidence.text: If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.
